Results.ReviewText: Absutely best value for the dollar ever!  Great grill, highly recommend it.
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: we love it.  I especially love how easy it is to empty the ashes.  Our first grill was a weber we got 8 years ago, and it's still going strong, no rust.  We still have that one as well, we just wanted to upgrade.  just have to replace the bolts.  Love my weber grills!!
Results.Title: Great product.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent multi-purpose griller/smoker. Cold smoke, hot smoke, grill it does it all
Results.Title: Classic for good reason

Results.ReviewText:
Bought mine to replace a cheaper grill that failed me the week before Memorial Day 2020. I can say that this has cooked up some great burgers, brats, dogs, steaks, and other items. 

Pros: Heat shield on lid handle, two spots for hanging your spatula or tongs on the side, like the ash sweeper in the bottom, storage for ash underneath is a nice add.

Cons: The ash collector at the bottom can be tricky to get out and its hard to see the level. I always end up with ash all over the porch when pulling it out.
Results.Title: How can you go wrong with charcoal?

Results.ReviewText: Finally replaced my first Weber Kettle, which served my family for 17 years. You can't beat the Weber Original Kettle 22" Grill, looking for another generation of wonderfully grilled food.
Results.Title: Love This Grill!!

Results.ReviewText: Still the same great grill from years ago. Glad we got the same type

If moving around off the concrete to use at another location, special attention needed to keep the leg from hitting the ground. If on an incline you can lose the lid. I'm not speaking of moving while in use.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is awesome.  The flip up sides on the grill grate are perfect for adding more charcoal. The temperature gauge is a great feature. It just looks so good.
Results.Title: Original Kettle premium charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: It’s a great grill you should include a stronger grate to give it a better quality buy
Results.Title: Grate to light

Results.ReviewText: Bought mine from Ace Hardware so I was able to find the Indigo color, which looks awesome. It’s my second 22” kettle, joining a black 22” that I’ve had for six years. If I had a complaint at all, my new indigo is missing the second handle that my black kettle has, so two fewer hooks for tools and would be useful for maneuverability.
Results.Title: Second handle?

Results.ReviewText: The grill was very easy to assemble, took maybe 15 minutes and we were able to have delicious barbecue for dinner the same day!
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using Weber charcoal grills since I first learned to grill and I’ve used home made grills. The Weber grill has come a long way since then lol. I love the way the legs lock in with a push button and I love the way the grate flips up on the two sides to add more charcoal for those long slow cooks the char baskets make it much easier to keep the charcoal where you want it and the charcoal lighter is better designed than the cheap ones
Results.Title: 22in kettle char basket chimney lighter

Results.ReviewText: It's a classic.  Often imitated, never replicated - is so true with this grill.  If you want consistent, predictable temperatures AND the ability to customize your grill for your purpose - there is only one.  The Weber Kettle Premium.
Results.Title: There Is Only One

Results.ReviewText: It’s great I love my kettle I can bbq anything on it and it’s easy to clean
Results.Title: Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful grill, typical Weber quality. I have been using it to smoke ribs and brisket as well as a rack of lamb! This grill is perfect for my needs.
Results.Title: The Weber Copper Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, love the flavor instead of gas grills.  I got the copper, it looks fabulous on my deck.  Easy to use and maintain.  Not my first Weber kettle grill.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We love our Weber. We bought this new Weber grill to replace our previous 22" Weber which lasted 17 years but finally rusted out (because we kept it outside and didn't put a cover on it). These grills work great, reliably cook great food, and are incredibly durable. Easy to assemble, too!
Results.Title: The best choice for old-school backyard cookouts!

Results.ReviewText: Outstanding product. Made an awesome 12 hr brisket that was the best we have had.
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill!

Results.ReviewText: Love it. So many companies try too reinvent the charcoal grill. Weber did it right the first time !
Results.Title: Weber is number one !

Results.ReviewText: This grill combined with the Weber coal chimney is the best and fastest way to cook. Fill the Weber chimney (not those cheep cans) with charcoal light two pieces of news paper underneath and 15mins later you are ready to go. Pile the coals to half the grill and use the indirect heat to cook and direct heat to sear.
Results.Title: cooking with Weber for years

Results.ReviewText: Best charcoal barbecue grill design. Dome design makes a big difference when it comes to cooking steaks. Need to add a table to the exploded view on the owners manual.
Results.Title: Quality: I have to slightly file the weld off legs

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill. You can't go wrong with the Weber Kettle especially the Premium version with the easy to use one touch cleaning system. I've grilled steaks, slow cooked ribs, cooked chicken on this and the taste and precision is phenomenal.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Premium

Results.ReviewText: First Weber grill. I love it. Sturdy and easy to clean. Food comes out great!
Results.Title: I’m on board!

Results.ReviewText: I usually grilled my meats over the for fire before buying this kettle. Since then I've been smoking meats every weekend without any modifications required. I would definitely recommend it to everyone.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love it and glad to have it in my front yard. The green color is perfect and all the features are amazing. The thermostat on top is dope.
Results.Title: Proudly display ournfront

Results.ReviewText: Weber is the best charcoal grill out there. I have owned many of them and love everyone of them. Son in law has a kamado  type grill.  The taste of food off a Weber is far superior then Kamado! Grand kids want me to make burgers for them! Buy a Weber and enjoy!
Results.Title: Best Grills

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
